name: Memorya
source:
May is an ordinary teenage girl living a simple, happy life. Yet beneath her smiles, she carries a quiet longing—an unspoken wish to find whatever piece of herself still feels missing.

But one night, on her way home, everything changes.

May suddenly finds herself with a group of strangers, facing challenges she never imagined. As she tries to survive and understand what’s going on, she’ll also start forming bonds, learning who she can trust... and who might break her.

In the end, will she discover love—or lose everything to despair?

[From [url=https://xlyn.itch.io/memorya-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅是一个普通的少女，过着简单而幸福的生活。然而，在她的微笑之下，却隐藏着一种安静的渴望——一种不言而喻的愿望，想要找到自己仍然缺失的那部分。

但有一天晚上，在她回家的路上，一切都发生了变化。

梅突然发现自己和一群陌生人在一起，面临着她从未想象过的挑战。当她试图生存并了解正在发生的事情时，她也会开始建立联系，了解她可以信任谁……以及谁可能会伤害她。

最终，她会发现爱情，还是因绝望而失去一切？

[来自[url=https://xlyn.itch.io/memorya-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
